title: The Narrow Pass
summary: In a chalk ravine, Los Lagartos blocks the route and insists Kael is the commander who knows the way to a buried cache. He moves because stopping would make their belief more dangerous.

panelPlan.text: Los Lagartos occupies the width of the narrow pass while loose white shale slips beneath everyone’s boots.
They indicate the only open route and wait for Kael to take the first step.
Kael looks once at the unstable wall, then walks at the head of the column without pretending he recognizes the ground.

title: Four Seconds
summary: Eva measures the ravine with a broken mirror and falling stones while Sand Rider reads the pressure change instead. Both are watching the same ground for different reasons.

panelPlan.text: Eva kicks a shale fragment into the blind drop and counts while Kael’s column edges along the opposite wall.
She angles a broken mirror into the hard glare. Sand Rider steps into the beam, blocking it with a layered canvas coat.
Sand Rider walks on parallel to the column. Eva lets the mirror fall into the chalk dust and follows.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eva
dialogueInline.text: Maybe five if it catches a root.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eva
dialogueInline.text: You could have said that before you blocked the light.

dialogueInline.speaker: Sand Rider
dialogueInline.text: You could have looked at the ridge.

title: Brass on Rusted Steel
summary: At the idling fuel skiff, Jessa forces Kael to acknowledge that the route is wrong without asking for a confession he cannot give.

panelPlan.text: Jessa fights a stripped intake valve with a wrench while the skiff vibrates under the basin heat.
Kael sets an unfamiliar brass map cylinder on the console between them and wipes chalk from his collar.
Jessa looks at the route marks, then at the basin wall, and pulls the throttle before the marching column reaches them.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jessa
dialogueInline.text: You walked them toward a sinkhole.

title: Flawed Calculations Above
summary: From an upper overlook, Veyra tries to force unstable ground back into the logic of her map. Eva notices the anchor itself is coming loose.

panelPlan.text: Veyra pins a rough map to black basalt with heavy brass optics while the distant column moves below.
Eva leans over the ridge and drops gravel. A deep fracture vibrates through their boots.
The steel piton backs out of the fissure by a fraction. Veyra immediately drops the tether and steps away from the edge.

title: Weight of the General
summary: At the sinkhole edge, reflected glare turns Kael’s shadow into the commander everyone expects. Eva pushes into the effect until the ground itself breaks the image.

panelPlan.text: Kael braces one bare hand against a half-buried artillery shell as the glare stretches his silhouette into something broader and armored.
Eva steps into his shadow and kicks the mirror shard against his boot, trying to make him look at the shape people see.
The basalt fractures. Kael releases the shell and steps into full light; the false silhouette collapses as the ordnance tips toward the void.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eva
dialogueInline.text: Then why don’t you tell them?

title: End of the Route
summary: The supposed cache is gone into a fresh tectonic sinkhole. The geography finally gives Los Lagartos something stronger than Kael’s resemblance.

panelPlan.text: The marching column reaches the lip of a collapsed crater where the route and the promised cache simply end.
Los Lagartos stands at the edge as the last dust falls into darkness. Their formation loosens for the first time.
Kael turns away and walks between the exhausted militia. Eva follows after one last look into the hole.
